targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'App Loaded' as step, uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) as users FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='custom_app_loaded' AND import_dataset='${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tests Menu', uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='custom_tests_menu_loaded' AND import_dataset='${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Pre-Test Loaded', uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='custom_pre_test_loaded' AND import_dataset='${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Test Completed', uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='custom_test_completed' AND import_dataset='${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Results Opened', uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='custom_results_screen_opened' AND import_dataset='${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Review Page', uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='custom_review_page_view' AND import_dataset='${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  count() AS completions
FROM analytics_events
WHERE event_name = 'custom_test_completed'
  AND import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  count() AS starts
FROM analytics_events
WHERE event_name = 'custom_pre_test_loaded'
  AND import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  countIf(event_name = 'custom_test_completed') / countIf(event_name = 'custom_pre_test_loaded') * 100 AS completion_rate
FROM analytics_events
WHERE event_name IN ('custom_test_completed', 'custom_pre_test_loaded')
  AND import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  uniqExactIf(user_pseudo_id, event_name = 'custom_review_page_view') / uniqExactIf(user_pseudo_id, event_name = 'custom_test_completed') * 100 AS review_rate
FROM analytics_events
WHERE event_name IN ('custom_review_page_view', 'custom_test_completed')
  AND import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT

WHERE event_name IN ('custom_pre_test_loaded', 'custom_app_loaded')
  AND import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
